about: The School Delay Watch's record for laporteweathernow.com: the watch's call for each La Porte County school morning as it stood at 8 p.m. the night before (from the National Weather Service forecast for La Porte), and what the districts did, from school-outcomes.txt. Our estimate, never an announcement: only the districts decide. Saved by the 'School Delay Watch record' job (scripts/school_call.py).
